evidence.evidence_text: To tackle the GMNER task, we construct a Twitter dataset based on two existing MNER datasets.
In recent years, Multimodal Named Entity Recognition (MNER) on social media has attracted considerable attention.
To solve these issues, in this work, we introduce a Grounded Multimodal Named Entity Recognition (GMNER) task.

Moreover, we extend four well-known MNER methods to establish a number of baseline systems and further propose a Hierarchical Index generation framework named H-Index, which generates the entity-type-region triples in a hierarchical manner with a sequence-to-sequence model.
To tackle the GMNER task, we construct a Twitter dataset based on two existing MNER datasets.
In recent years, Multimodal Named Entity Recognition (MNER) on social media has attracted considerable attention.
Experiment results on our annotated dataset demonstrate the superiority of our H-Index framework over baseline systems on the GMNER task.
